line: # Re-read of the worked example on m0003 (LX-TR, 25 Sept 2026), digit by digit from the image
# (crop /tmp scratchpad, 2x zoom on the two-line example block), independent of the orchestrator's
# own quote of this passage in NOTES.md. All 12 groups match NOTES.md's existing transcription
# exactly, and every group parses under the key's own stated rule: first digit d1 in {1,2,3} gives
# the page as the next d1 digits, the digit after that (in {1,2,3}) is the column, and the remaining
# digits (>=1) are the rank. The key text's own worked-through explanation for group 1 (1131 -> pag.1,
# col.3, rank.1) and group 2 (322212 -> pag.222, col.1, rank.2) on m0003-m0004 matches this parse
# exactly, confirming the rule as read. No group here starts with a null digit (4-9); this worked
# example does not illustrate the null/English-dictionary-switch case, only m0002's live ciphertext does.
# (25 Sept 2026, LX-DEC: row 5 corrected 23312 -> 23812 per LX-BOOK's flag in ROOM.md/NOTES.md, after

# figure-eight loop, matching the "8" at the end of group 4 (321118) two groups earlier, not the open
# "3"s used elsewhere on the same line. book_page/col/rank updated to 38/1/2 (LX-BOOK's BOOK.md).)
